## Quarto

# Introduction

-   What does this data represent?

-   What is measured?

-   How was it collected?

# Description of Data Cleaning 

-   Is there any data missingness or other errors? How can this be corrected?

-   Do the measurements make sense in context? (you might need to discuss with the instructor what to do if not)

# Exploratory Data Analysis 

-   What relationships can you observe visually?

-   Summary statistics

-   What other data might you collect to augment this dataset? Is it available?

# Research Questions 

-   Are there any ethical implications of the research questions we might ask of the data?

-   Research Questions
